Save the admin, end the setup token and log in.

put.description: Save all settings. Workers reload them on the `settings` bus topic.

get.description: The config as a JSON file download.

post.description:
Check the file, then save the settings and the container values in one transaction.

A dry run gives the counts and the errors and saves nothing. A real import of a
bad file gives 422. Containers that WT does not know yet get a new row.

Start a check run in the background. 409 if a run is active.

With `group` (a group label of the container list), check only the containers of
that app. 404 if no live container is in the group.

put.description: Set, confirm or clear the release source. A cleared source stays clear (confirmed).

get.description:
Containers that exist in Docker now and are not excluded, in Compose groups.

Groups are sorted by label; "Other" (no project) is last. Containers by name.

schema.title: Response List Containers Api Containers Get

get.description: One container with its current update and its events. 404 if it is not in Docker now.

The log as SSE: one event per line, {time, stream, text}.

When the client goes, WT stops the Docker log stream.
The full log as a text file, no follow. Line: <time> <stream> <text>.
The current values, the counts and the groups (in the order of /api/containers).

CPU and memory of the last 60 full minutes (the `1m` rows) for each container.
The current minute is not in it: WT saves it at the next minute.
The VM charts of a range: CPU, memory, disk I/O, network and load.

The container charts of a range: CPU, memory, network and disk I/O. 404 if the
container is not in Docker now. The history stays after a recreate (same name).
